mission_10: The ultimate test of an imputation strategy is its impact on downstream model performance. Rather than evaluating imputation quality in isolation, this approach measures how well each strategy preserves the predictive information in the data. By wrapping each imputation method in a sklearn Pipeline with a classifier and evaluating via cross-validation, you can objectively rank strategies based on their real-world utility. This methodology accounts for the interaction between imputation and modeling, revealing cases where a theoretically inferior imputation method actually produces better predictions. The approach also quantifies the trade-off between imputation complexity and model performance, helping you choose the simplest method that achieves acceptable results. This is the gold standard for imputation evaluation in production machine learning systems.
